meta.title: 闪光灯快门250或更慢，可以加中灰滤镜
meta.title_en: Flash at 1/250 or Slower, and You Can Use ND Filters

scenes.title_cn: 开场：很多人不知道，把闪光灯快门设置…
scenes.title_en: Opening: many don't know that at 1/250s or…
scenes.context: 慢快门+ND镜近似高速同步。
sentences: 把闪光灯快门设置在250分之一秒或更慢，完全可以使用中灰滤镜。
At 1/250s or slower, you can fully use ND filters with flash.
ND filters（中灰滤镜）
这不是高速同步，但配合ND镜可以获得接近高速同步的玩法。
This isn't HSS, but ND mirrors much of its behavior.
close to HSS（接近高速同步）
同时不损失闪光灯功率。
And it sacrifices no flash power.
no power loss（不损失功率）
paraphrase: close to HSS（接近高速同步
close to HSS（接近高速同步
scenes.speak: At 1/250s or slower, you can fully use ND filters with flash. This isn't HSS, but ND mirrors much of its behavior. And it sacrifices no flash power.

scenes.title_cn: 原理：为什么可以？因为闪光灯输出持续…
scenes.title_en: Why it works: the flash burst is far short…
scenes.context: 闪光持续时间决定同步可行性。
sentences: 闪光灯输出持续时间远短于250分之一秒。
The flash burst is far shorter than 1/250s.
flash duration（闪光持续时间）
只要快门比闪光持续时间慢，闪光就能被完整记录。
As long as the shutter is slower than the flash duration, the flash is fully recorded.
shutter vs flash duration（快门vs闪光时长）
ND镜的作用只是压暗环境光，不影响闪光灯照亮的范围。
ND only dims ambient light, leaving flash-lit areas unaffected.
dims ambient（压暗环境光）
scenes.speak: The flash burst is far shorter than 1/250s. As long as the shutter is slower than the flash duration, the flash is fully recorded. ND only dims ambient light, leaving flash-lit areas unaffected.

scenes.title_cn: 实操：场景是正午户外，想用大光圈虚化…
scenes.title_en: In practice: noon outdoor shoot, wanting w…
sentences: 场景是正午户外，想用大光圈虚化背景。
The scene: noon outdoor, wanting wide-aperture bokeh.
wide-aperture bokeh（大光圈虚化）
装ND64滤镜，ISO100，快门250分之一秒，光圈f1.4。
Mount ND64, ISO 100, shutter 1/250s, aperture f/1.4.
背景被压暗，主体依然明亮，闪光灯功率没被削减。
The background darkens while the subject stays bright—no flash power cut.
no flash power cut（功率不减）
paraphrase: no flash power cut（功率不减
no flash power cut（功率不减
scenes.speak: The scene: noon outdoor, wanting wide-aperture bokeh. Mount ND64, ISO 100, shutter 1/250s, aperture f/1.4. The background darkens while the subject stays bright—no flash power cut.

scenes.title_cn: 与高速同步对比：高速同步的代价是闪光…
scenes.title_en: Compared with HSS: HSS pays with heavily a…
scenes.context: 对比高速同步，明确代价与边界。
sentences: 高速同步的代价是闪光灯输出大幅衰减。
HSS's price is heavily attenuated flash output.
HSS attenuation（高速同步衰减）
250分之一秒加ND镜完全不衰减功率，输出更稳定。
The 1/250-plus-ND route keeps full power and stability.
full power（满功率）
局限是没法超过250分之一秒来凝固瞬间。
The limit: you can't freeze motion faster than 1/250s.
freeze motion（凝固瞬间）
scenes.speak: HSS's price is heavily attenuated flash output. The 1/250-plus-ND route keeps full power and stability. The limit: you can't freeze motion faster than 1/250s.

practice: At 1/250s the flash burst is fully recorded.
ND keeps full power while HSS attenuates.
Great for portraits, can't freeze motion.
pitfalls: ND only dims ambient, flash-lit areas stay bright.
ND只压环境光，不影响闪光范围。
Use HSS and accept power loss.
1/250s plus ND keeps full flash power.
The limit is 1/250s; fast action needs HSS.
凝固瞬间受限于250分之一秒。
ND keeps wide apertures usable at noon.
shifts: 用 ND filter（中灰滤镜）、dim ambient（压暗环境光）
用 flash duration（闪光持续时间）、1/250s（同步速度）、HSS（高速同步）
用 full power（满功率）、bokeh（虚化）、freeze motion（凝固瞬间）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：快门250或更慢、中灰滤镜、不是高速同步、不损失功率、闪光持续时间、ND压暗环境光、正午户外、大光圈、ND64、ISO100、f1.4、TTL、深色调、高速同步衰减、凝固瞬间等。
